title: PAR(2) Discovery Engine: A Reproducible Methods Platform for Temporal Persistence Analysis of Gene Expression Time Series
description:
Full source code, embedded datasets, reproducibility package, and pre-computed results for the PAR(2) Discovery Engine. The platform implements AR(2) eigenvalue modulus analysis of gene expression time series and reproducibly identifies a Clock > target > housekeeping temporal persistence hierarchy across 22 datasets in 5 species.

Key components:
- AR(2) eigenvalue solver (TypeScript and Python)
- Atlas computation pipeline across 12 mouse tissues
- Phase-gated AR(2) analysis for circadian interaction detection
- Standalone reproducibility package with 3 embedded datasets
- Pre-computed results: 20,955-gene eigenvalue atlas, permutation null distribution, nine-category statistical tests

The PAR(2) Discovery Engine web platform is accessible at https://par2discovery.com.
notes: Pending UK patent application GB2518973.9 covers the PAR(2) mathematical framework. Academic/non-commercial use is free with citation. Commercial use requires a separate licence (contact mickwh@msn.com).
